items.title: Loading progress bar too thin and low-contrast
items.what: In the initial boot screen, the horizontal rule under 'Downloading the game' is a single-pixel dark brown line on near-black, with no fill or glow.
items.why: Players cannot gauge download progress on a phone screen at arm's length, increasing perceived wait time and frustration before the first interaction.
items.how: Replace the rule with a 4 px high rounded rect using the existing warm gold color at 60 % opacity, and add a subtle inner glow matching the logo.

items.title: Sticks shown during pre-fight countdown
items.what: Images 2, 10 and 13 show both full-opacity stance and technique sticks with their labels at the bottom while the large gold 'FIGHT IN X' button is counting down.
items.why: New players instinctively touch the sticks before the round starts, causing accidental inputs or confusion about when control begins.
items.how: Fade the entire bottom control cluster to 25 % opacity and disable raycasting while the countdown button is visible; restore on 'FIGHT'.

items.title: Player names and scores too small in HUD
items.what: The top bar shows 'ASMONGOLD 0' and 'HASANABI 0' in ~11 px light text with the 30-timer in a gold pill; names are hard to read on 390 px width.
items.why: On a phone held in portrait, players cannot quickly confirm which side they are on or track the score without leaning in, breaking immersion during fast exchanges.
items.how: Increase name/score font to 15 px, add 1 px warm outline, and give the timer pill a darker brown fill so the gold numerals pop.

items.title: Move callout text too small and low-contrast
items.what: The centered black pill showing 'FRONT KICK' or 'LUNGE PUNCH' uses small light text on a semi-transparent dark bar that sits above the bright dojo floor.
items.why: During rapid exchanges the label is easy to miss, so players never learn which stick combination produced the move they just saw.
items.how: Make the pill wider, use 18 px bold gold text with a thin dark outline, and keep it on screen for 800 ms with a quick fade.

items.title: Settings toggles have poor off-state visibility
items.what: In the settings modal the 'Reduced motion', 'High contrast' etc. switches show a tiny white circle on dark when off, with almost no track contrast.
items.why: Players on a dim phone cannot tell at a glance which accessibility options are active, especially the left-handed layout toggle they just changed.
items.how: Give the track a warm brown fill when off and a brighter gold fill when on; enlarge the thumb to 22 px with a 2 px ring.
